questions.question: The term ‘Shido’ is used in Judo for ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**minor penalty.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shido** is a **minor penalty **in Judo that is given to a player for **breaking minor rules** or **not following the instructions **of the referee.
 
• It is a** warning** to the player to **correct their behavior**, and if they continue to break the rules, they may be given a** more severe penalty.**
 
• Shido is represented by a **small white card**, and a player can receive up to** three Shidos **before being disqualified from the match.
 
• Shido is an important aspect of Judo as it ensures** fair play and discourages players** from **breaking the rules** intentionally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Throwing skill **(Option 2) in Judo is called **Nage-waza**, which includes techniques such as **Osoto-gari, Uchi-mata, and Seoi-nage.**
 
• **Defensive skill** (Option 3) in Judo is called **Katame-waza, **which includes techniques such as **Arm locks, Chokes, and Pinning techniques.**
 
• **Points** (Option 4) in Judo are awarded for** throwing an opponent on their back** or** holding them down** for a certain amount of time. 
 
 
• The player with the **most points** at the end of the match** wins.**

questions.question: For which of the following reasons 'slash and burn' method of farming is adopted?
questions.solution:
The correct option is 3 - **To replenish soil fertility.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Slash and burn' method of farming involves cutting down and burning trees and plants in a forested area to create a patch of land for farming.**
 
• The **ash from the burned vegetation adds nutrients to the soil, making it fertile for crops.**
 
• This** method is usually practiced by indigenous communities in tropical regions where the soil is poor**, and the climate is humid.
 
• However, **if this method is overused, it can lead to deforestation and soil degradation, making it unsustainable in the long run.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** To clear the area quickly:**

 
• The '**slash and burn' method is used to clear the area of vegetation quickly**, but it is not the primary reason for adopting this method.

**To reduce soil fertility:**

 
• The 'slash and burn' method is used to replenish soil fertility, not reduce it.

**To cause pollution:**

 
• **The 'slash and burn' method is not used to cause pollution intentionally**. However, the burning of vegetation can release harmful gases into the atmosphere, which can cause pollution.

questions.question: Aryabhatta was India's first artificial satellite in space, launched in the year ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1975.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aryabhatta **was **India's first satellite** in space, launched in the** year 1975** by the **Soviet Union.**
 
• It was named after the **famous Indian mathematician Aryabhatta **who made significant contributions to the **field of astronomy.**
 
• The satellite was designed to** study X-rays, gamma rays, and cosmic rays** and to conduct experiments in **solar physics.**
 
• It orbited the Earth for** four years** before re-entering the atmosphere and burning up.
 
• **Option 1**, 1925, is** incorrect **as India did not have the capability to launch satellites in that year.
 
• **Option 2**, 1990, is also** incorrect** as India launched its first satellite, Aryabhata, in 1975.
 
• **Option 4**, 1945, is **incorrect **as India did not have any satellite launch capabilities during that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The launch of Aryabhatta marked India's entry into the** field of space research and technology.**
 
• The satellite weighed **360 kg **and was placed in a **near-Earth orbit** at an altitude of** 619 km.**
 
• The success of Aryabhatta paved the way for the development of India's space program, which has since launched **numerous satellites** for a variety of applications.
 
• India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was named after the **same mathematician**, but it was launched by India in **1975.**

questions.question: The first layer of earth’s atmosphere is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Troposphere.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first layer** of the **Earth's atmosphere** is called the** troposphere.**
 
• It is the layer closest to the **Earth's surface, **extending from the surface up to about **7-20 km (4-12 miles)** depending on the location.
 
• The troposphere contains about **80%** of the **total mass** of the Earth's atmosphere and is where** weather occurs.**
 
• **Temperature decreases** with height in the troposphere, due to the** cooling effect **of the Earth's surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stratosphere: **the **layer above the troposphere,** extending from about **20-50 km** (12-31 miles) above the surface.

 
 
• It contains the** ozone layer**, which absorbs** harmful ultraviolet radiation** from the sun.
 
 
 
• **Thermosphere: **the layer **above the mesosphere**, extending from about **80-600 km** (50-375 miles) above the surface.
 
 
• It is where the **auroras occur** and is the location of the **International Space Station.**
 
 
 
• **Mesosphere:** the layer **above **the stratosphere, extending from about **50-80 km** (31-50 miles) above the surface.
 
 
• It is the **coldest layer of the atmosphere **and** meteors burn **up in this layer.
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "The first layer of the Earth's atmosphere is the troposphere" is **correct.**

questions.question: How many Schedules are there in the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Constitution of India **has **12 schedules, **which are essentially lists or** annexures **that provide additional details about various aspects of the Constitution.
 
• The schedule**s** cover topics such as** languages, forms of oaths, allocation of seats **in the **Rajya Sabha, **and** tribal areas**.
 
• Each schedule is **numbered** and has a specific purpose, such as **Schedule 1** which contains the **names of States **and** Union Territories.**
 
• The schedules can be amended by **Parliament **through a special majority vote, as per** Article 368** of the Constitution.
 
• Option 2, 3, and 4 are** incorrect** as there are more than 9, 10, and 11 schedules respectively in the Constitution of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: There are more than 10 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is **incorrect.**
 
• **Option 3:** There are more than 11 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is** incorrect.**
 
• **Option 4**: There are more than 9 schedules in the Constitution of India, therefore this option is **incorrect.**

questions.question: The Moth ki Masjid was built in the reign of ______ ruler.
questions.solution:

__

• The mosque is known for its **unique architectural style** and **intricate designs.**
 
• Firuz Shah Tugluq, Muhammad Tughluq, and Bahlul Lodi were rulers of the Delhi Sultanate but did not build the Moth ki Masjid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Firuz Shah Tugluq** was a ruler of the Tugluq dynasty who ruled from **1351 to 1388.** 

 
 
• He is known for his contributions to the** development of Delhi,** including the construction of **many public works.**
 
 
 
• **Muhammad Tughluq **was a ruler of the Tughluq dynasty who ruled from** 1325 to 1351.** 
 
 
• He is known for his ambitious but ultimately unsuccessful attempts at **administrative reform.**
 
 
 
• **Bahlul Lodi** was a ruler of the Lodi dynasty who ruled from **1451 to 1489.** 
 
 
• He is known for his **military campaigns** and expansion of the Lodi empire.
